_about: Store and build ids for the three Expo apps, in one place (R19). Each apps/<app>/app.config.js reads this file through packages/mobile-core/plugins/store-config.js. A value written {LIKE_THIS} is a placeholder: fill it in when the account or project exists (docs/launch/store/README.md); never guess. A production build (EAS profile production, or EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production) refuses to start while any value it needs is still a placeholder. The bundle ids and packages are the ones already chosen in apps/<app>/app.json.
